name: keen
description: Sharp-eyed UI/UX review and design-system workflows for Codex. Requires the separately installed local Keen CLI and Playwright Chromium runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Spot UI issues and shape stronger systems
interface.longDescription: Give rendered interfaces a keen eye: measure design and accessibility signals, compare named systems, characterize AI-default patterns and visual taste, and turn evidence into validated design-system proposals. The plugin supplies model workflows; the local Keen CLI and Playwright Chromium runtime are installed separately.
defaultPrompt: Review this interface and prioritize the top three fixes.
Find the strongest AI-default patterns in this UI.
Turn this captured run into a coherent design system.
